meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 会在你的 NanoClaw 群组里搭一个持久 wiki 知识库:建 wiki/ 和 sources/ 目录、index.md 与 log.md,在群组 CLAUDE.md 中加入 wiki 维护规则,并生成对应的容器技能文件。
howto.when: 当你提到「add wiki」「wiki」「knowledge base」等关键词,或要求给某个群组搭建持久知识库时触发。

say.text: 给这个群组加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: Claude 会先问你选哪个群组,再开始搭建

say.text: 把这份 PDF 收进 wiki
say.note: 它会逐个文件读取、讨论要点并更新页面

say.text: 每周做一次 wiki 健康检查
say.note: 用 schedule_task 安排定期的 lint 任务

howto.what_en: Adds a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group: creates wiki/ and sources/ folders with index.md and log.md, adds a wiki section to the group's CLAUDE.md, and a container skill describing ingest, query and lint.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "add wiki", "wiki" or "knowledge base", or ask to set up a persistent knowledge base for a NanoClaw group.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group
say_en.note: It asks which group first, then starts setup

say_en.text: Ingest this PDF into the wiki
say_en.note: It reads files one at a time and updates pages

say_en.text: Run a weekly wiki health check
say_en.note: Schedules a periodic lint task via schedule_task
